# Founder OS Starter

> The vanilla pattern for a personal command centre that works across multiple AI tools: eleven rooms, each answering one question, run on honest data. Built by Wendy Harris (Fourteen Seed) and shared so people can build their own with their agent's help.

This repo is documentation, not software. There is nothing to install. An agent reading this repo should start with AGENTS.md for its instructions, then the principles, then the rooms.

## Structure

- [README.md](README.md): the human front door: who this is for and how to use it
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for the agent a visitor points at this repo
- [principles/the-campus.md](principles/the-campus.md): the operating analogy: buildings, colleagues, keycards, the gatehouse, the pillars, the green
- [principles/honesty-rules.md](principles/honesty-rules.md): the non-negotiable rules every room obeys
- [principles/credits.md](principles/credits.md): what this borrows, from whom, and what was changed
- [start-here/first-week.md](start-here/first-week.md): the build order that actually worked
- [start-here/running-it-locally.md](start-here/running-it-locally.md): the local server, the login service, and the data compiles, in plain terms
- [start-here/how-it-comes-alive.md](start-here/how-it-comes-alive.md): the practical wiring for a multi-tool stack (Claude, Codex, Hermes or cron, a task board): the heartbeat loop, the work loop, and the human loop
- [templates/task-record.md](templates/task-record.md): the Open Engine task record and receipts vocabulary, copy-paste ready
- rooms/: one file per room, numbered in daily-loop order; each states the question it answers, the analogy, what's on the page, the rule it carries, its inspiration, and how to build your own
